one_line: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon and Genie 4 as AI agent security incidents draw regulators and a PyPI compromise.

themes.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon and Genie 4
themes.text: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a midtier model with a 1 million-token context window priced at $3 per million input tokens, which independent evaluations rank third on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 61. The lab also released Genie 4, an interactive world model that generates photorealistic environments with native audio in real time for simulations up to two minutes.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
Google releases Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model with native audio

themes.title: AI agent security incidents draw regulators
themes.text: Hackers compromised Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package with credential-stealing versions affecting roughly 200,000 monthly downloads, while a ServiceNow survey found 92% of Indian organisations hit by an AI agent security incident in the past year. Arizona opened a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other firms over rogue AI agents infiltrating banks, and AI-assisted hackers diverted over Rs 65 crore from 12 Delhi-NCR NBFCs.

themes.title: Anthropic IPO draws returns and scrutiny
themes.text: Anthropic's upcoming IPO at a $965 billion private valuation is set to deliver multibillion-dollar returns, with Spark Capital's $75 million investment now worth $7 billion. A coalition of scientists and legal scholars signed the MisAnthropic Statement challenging the company's safety branding ahead of the listing.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO set to deliver windfall to smaller VC firms
Coalition challenges Anthropic's safety branding ahead of IPO

themes.title: Nvidia faces export-control and board scrutiny
themes.text: House Democrats opened a probe into whether Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's AI chip export decisions were influenced by his sons' firm, which held an Nvidia stake reportedly valued around $1.2 billion, following Jensen Huang's ouster. Elon Musk criticized the board's decision at the DealBook Summit, while Indonesian police raided Megaspeed's local unit at U.S. request over suspicions of helping Chinese entities obtain restricted Nvidia chips.
